text: Behind the rotunda. <break time="0.8s" /> The slender trees with yellow leaves hung down. <break time="0.8s" /> And through them she could see. <break time="0.8s" /> A line of sea. <break time="0.8s" /> And the blue sky with gold veined clouds. <break time="0.8s" /> Two young girls in red came by and two young soldiers in blue met them. <break time="0.8s" /> And they laughed and paired off. <break time="0.8s" /> And went away arm in arm. <break time="0.8s" /> Two peasant women in funny straw hats passed. <break time="0.8s" /> Gravely leading. <break time="0.8s" /> Beautiful smoke colored donkeys. <break time="0.8s" /> And a cold, pale nun hurried by. <break time="0.8s" /> A beautiful woman came along. <break time="0.8s" /> And dropped her bunch of violets. <break time="0.8s" /> And a little boy ran after her. <break time="0.8s" /> To hand them back to her. <break time="0.8s" /> She took them. <break time="0.8s" /> And threw them away. <break time="0.8s" /> As if they had been poisoned. <break time="0.8s" /> And Miss Brill did not know. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether to admire that or not. <break time="0.8s" /> Then a woman in an ermine toque. <break time="0.8s" /> Met a gentleman in grey. <break time="0.8s" /> Right in front of her. <break time="0.8s" /> And even her face was the color. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the shabby ermine. <break time="0.8s" /> She was delighted to see him. <break time="0.8s" /> And talked brightly. <break time="0.8s" /> But he shook his head. <break time="0.8s" /> Slowly breathed a great puff of smoke. <break time="0.8s" /> Into her face. <break time="0.8s" /> And walked on. <break time="0.8s" /> Left alone. <break time="0.8s" /> She smiled more brightly than ever. <break time="0.8s" /> While the drum beat The Brute, The Brute. <break time="0.8s" /> And then she pretended to see someone nicer. <break time="0.8s" /> And pattered away.
